title: Big Omega
definition: Big Omega (Ω) defines the lower bound of an algorithm. It describes the absolute best-case scenario (e.g., finding the target element on the very first try).
simpleExplanation: The absolute fastest possible time it could ever finish if the stars align perfectly.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Big Omega.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Big Omega to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Big Omega (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Big Omega for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Big Omega in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
